name: Organizer base to desk support plane

coordinate_frame.origin: centre of the flat printed footprint
coordinate_frame.y_positive: toward the rear of the body

datums.description: flat printed underside acting as both build-plate seat and desk seat

allowed: lifting the whole body off the desk

assembly.direction: place the body on its flat printed underside
assembly.contact_mode: gravity-supported planar contact, optional felt liner
assembly.sequence_notes: Dry flat indoor surfaces only. The flat underside is also the support-free print seat.

environment_and_variation.environment: dry adult indoor desk or shelf, room temperature, no power delivery under load
uncontrolled: as-built mass and centre of gravity of the generated body
lateral force a user applies while pressing a cable into a channel

keepouts_and_access: Do not claim anti-slip performance from geometry alone.
Do not claim wall, vehicle or shelf-edge mounting.

loads_and_performance.host_load: several slack low-voltage cables; no tension is carried
loads_and_performance.stability_test: 10-degree base tilt with every declared channel loaded

evidence.uncertainty_note: The support concept and its test are specified, but the generated body has no recorded mass, centre of gravity or measured footprint area, and no physical desk surface has been tested.

failure_modes.mode: The body tips while a user presses a cable into a high tentacle channel.
failure_modes.effect: The organizer falls over and cables are released.
failure_modes.mitigation: Keep the centre of gravity low, maximise the flat footprint, verify a 10-degree tilt with all channels loaded.

acceptance_criteria: With every declared channel loaded, the body remains upright after a 10-degree base tilt.
The body does not slide when a cable is pressed into the highest channel with one hand.
